basic_info.description: Welcome to the Historic Nob Hill neighborhood. Nestled on charming Pleasant Street - a quiet, sun filled alley named after Mary Ellen Pleasant, this stunning Edwardian condo offers timeless elegance in one of San Francisco's most iconic locations.     This beautifully maintained 2 bedroom 2 bath home is part of an intimate 4 unit building, with each unit enjoying its own dedicated storage. The condo features an updated kitchen, a spacious in-unit laundry area, and abundant natural light throughout. Just steps away from Huntington Park and the iconic Grace Cathedral Church, you'll also enjoy easy access to downtown Trader Joe's and vibrant North Beach. Whether you're commuting or exploring, the convenience of this location is truly unmatched. The building's exterior was recently painted, offering great curb appeal. This is a MUST SEE opportunity ideal for first time home buyers or anyone who is seeking for a classic home in a prime SF location. There is a parking garage located one block away for $400 per month.    Location, character, and charm - this one has it all!
